seoTitle: GCPS Calendar 2027-2028: Gwinnett Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: GCPS 2027-2028 calendar with Aug 4 first day, May 24 last day, fall break, Thanksgiving, winter break, spring break, digital learning days and PDF.
calendarNotes: Gwinnett County Public Schools lists 180 student days for 2027-2028. The first day of school is August 4, 2027 and the last day is May 24, 2028. Fall Break is October 11-15, Thanksgiving Break is November 22-26, Winter Break is December 20-31, 2027, and Spring Break is April 3-7, 2028. GCPS also publishes 2027-2028 calendar PDFs in Chinese, Korean, Spanish, and Vietnamese.

calendarFaqs.q: When does GCPS start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Gwinnett County Public Schools starts the 2027-2028 school year on Wednesday, August 4, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is GCPS Fall Break in 2027?
When is GCPS Winter Break in 2027-2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break school holidays run December 20-31, 2027. January 3 is a teacher planning and staff development day, and students begin the second semester on January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: Does GCPS publish translated calendars for 2027-2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. GCPS publishes 2027-2028 calendar PDFs in Chinese, Korean, Spanish, and Vietnamese in addition to the English version.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for GCPS in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Wednesday, May 24, 2028.
